Topic Tracker

Track your study progress across all CPALE subjects

🎯 Confidence Level Guide — What do the dots mean?
Rate how well you understand each topic from 1–5. This is your confidence in the topic itself — not how many times you watched a lecture.
Level 1I read/heard it but can't explain it — total confusion.
Level 2I have a rough idea but would struggle on exam questions.
Level 3I understand the basics but need more practice and review.
Level 4I'm quite confident — I can answer most questions on this topic.
Level 5Fully mastered — I can teach this topic and ace any question.

🤖 AI Study Coach
Koda uses built-in rule-based replies for common study questions. It does not have a local language model, so its understanding is limited without an external AI provider.
External API keys are optional and are only used when configured.

Add a provider key if you want free-form answers beyond the built-in rules.

Optional fallback. Get a free key.
Gemini (Optional Fallback)

Mode & Theme
Typography
Tip: the top group are all similar modern sans-serif fonts, so switching between them can look subtle. Pick one from the other groups if you want a change that's obvious at a glance.
Scales text and spacing across the whole app — sidebar, tables, dashboard, everything — not just this page.
Make Your Own Look
No color theory needed. Pick a main color and a mood — the app builds the rest of the palette for you.
1. CHOOSE YOUR MAIN COLOR
This is the color people will notice most.
2. PICK A MOOD
ADVANCED: CHOOSE ALL 3 COLORS YOURSELF
Mood: Soft
quiet, airy & gentle — this choice changes the whole atmosphere, not just the palette.
💡 Tip: If you just want a pretty theme, choose one main color + a mood. The app will keep the colors gentle and coordinated.
Subject Colors
Set your own color for each subject — used across the tracker, dashboard rings, and scoresheet.
💾 Backup Status
Local Backup
💡 Save to File lets you pick or create a .json file. On Chrome/Edge, it auto-saves every 3 seconds after any change — the ✓ indicator next to the button confirms autosave. LocalStorage backup is always active.

🔒 Tip: point it at a folder synced by Google Drive, OneDrive, or Dropbox and every autosave becomes an off-device backup automatically — no extra steps.
☁️ Google Drive Backup

Connect your own Google Drive to back up automatically. This app can only ever see the one backup file it creates — never anything else in your Drive — and your data goes straight from your browser to your Drive. It never passes through our servers.

⚠ Safety Net

Before any import or reset, a snapshot of your current data is saved automatically so a wrong click never has to be permanent.

About

CPALE Ready — your focused CPA board exam companion.
Track: subjects, topics, scores, schedules, achievements, and study history.
Improve: use Insights, retention checks, planning tools, and KODA Study Coach guidance.
Local-first: your data stays in this browser; internet is mainly needed for initial loading, fonts, or optional online features.

Move Selected Topics

Move the selected topics together. Their order stays the same.

⧉ Merge Topics

Combine the selected topics into one. Their practice scores, calendar sessions, and confidence/status history all move to the surviving topic — nothing is lost, the topic count just goes down.

🔀 Transfer Topics

Move the selected topics to a different sub-subject — even under a different subject. Their status, confidence, and history follow them.

🧩 Organize Topics

Select a topic, then tell the tracker where you want it. No dragging required.

Add / Edit Topic

Smart placement keeps numbered continuations together when the pattern is clear.

Add Sub-subject

Choose whether this sub-subject contains regular study topics or video lectures. Video Lectures get their own progress bar and aren't counted in the subject's overall completion.

🔀 Transfer Sub-subject

Handy if a sub-subject was accidentally added under the wrong main subject. Its topics, progress, and video/topics type all move with it — only the main subject it's filed under changes.

⚡ Bulk Add Topics

📚 Regular study topics
For video lecture sets like Introduction to Income Tax_1 through _20 — fill in the base name and the number range, and every topic gets generated automatically.
Paste one topic name per line — handy when your lecture titles aren't a clean numbered sequence.

Add Score Entry

Setting Quiz Type to "Preboard" or "Mock Exam" auto-fills default Max Items. Edit freely.
